requires: An M-VAVE FM-1 running stock V15 or official fm1_open firmware. If it runs stock V15, this page installs official Open first
Chrome or Edge on a computer, with MIDI and SysEx allowed
Anything you want to keep backed up. On official Open, M-VAVE's workbench backs up projects, samples and voices. Stock V15 has no project library for it to read

notes: Firmware 0.9.4 can clear a pattern: on PATTERN, hold SEQ and press REC. Every step of every page goes off, and the length, tempo and kit stay. SAVE+OCT− undoes it.

GLITCH's kick is a kick again. It had a siren's pitch sweep and two kinds of drive, and played 5 dB over the rest of its kit; now it is level with it. The kick in every kit now skips those extras, so NOISE's and ACID's kicks lose some filter drive too. The other kits are unchanged.
Copying a page, already there: pick a page with its black key, hold SEQ and press OCT− to copy, pick another page, hold SEQ and press OCT+ to paste.

0.9.3 runs on one unit: the install, start-up with FAULTS at 0, project names and MIDI notes. 0.9.4 has not run on a device: it is tested on the host and in the FM-1 emulator, including under the chip's alignment rule. Bluetooth, long runs and leaving for official firmware are untested.
If an FM-1 is restarting at the start-up screen: power on holding HOME until SAFE MODE shows, then connect the installer. This has not been tried on a device.
